title: Deploy runway — onprem VPC daynotes
body:
Context: quick scratchpad for the morning run — customer: NorthStar Analytics (airgapped VPC in us-west-2). I'm oncall for the install pair today (Priya). This is informal runbook + TODOs + blockers to push to Mateo/Evelyn later.

Primary goals
- Finish appliance bootstrap and join to customer VPC (10.2.0.0/16).
- Bring up model-serving runtime (v2.4.1) behind the internal ELB for test tenancy.
- Validate KV cache persistence and cold-start latency baseline.

Morning quick checklist (live):
[ ] Confirm cust firewall opened 1194, 443, 2200 -> appliance (10.2.32.14).
[ ] Upload cert bundle to /etc/redwood/certs (customer-signed).
[ ] Verify HSM integration test key can encrypt/decrypt (shim test).
[ ] Start installer in dry-run mode, capture logs to local:~/deploy-logs/runway-2025-10-22.log

Notes / commands I ran
- pulled install image: docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/onprem-installer:2025-10-15
- bootstrap: sudo ./installer bootstrap --appliance-host 10.2.32.14 --env prod --region us-west-2 --secrets /tmp/nsa-bundle.tar.gz
- quick check for services: sudo systemctl status redwood-runtime redwood-agent redwood-kvcache
- kernel tuning we applied: sysctl -w vm.swappiness=10; sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1
- mounted NFS: sudo mount -t nfs 10.2.32.11:/export/models /var/lib/redwood/models -o vers=4,proto=tcp

Observed oddities / blockers so far
- Agent kept restarting until we applied the new GPU driver (nvidia 535.86). Error in /var/log/redwood-agent.log: "nvmlInit failed: library not found". Resolved by installing driver from customer staging repo.
- Customer proxy intercepting pod registry calls — had to whitelist ghcr.io and registry.redwood.local in their proxy ACLs.
- KV cache recovery latency high (~3s cold lookup). Hypothesis: NFS mount stats (sync vs async) + small I/O pattern. Plan: test with local tmpfs for cache and compare.

Environment reminders (customer-specific)
- IP plan: management 10.2.32.0/27 (appliances 10.2.32.14-17 reserved), model nodes 10.2.33.0/24
- DNS suffix: ns.local.northstar
- Internal ELB health check path: /_health?env=prod, expects 200 within 2s
- No external internet; only egress via customer-managed proxy (10.2.16.5:3128)

Post-install test matrix (short)
- Smoke: curl -k https://10.2.32.14:443/_health -> expect 200 within 2s
- Inference: run small prompt through runtime: 
  curl -s -X POST https://10.2.32.14:443/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --insecure
  Check: token latency < 80ms average for 16 token output (baseline from hosted is ~45ms).
- KV cache test: run sequence with repeated prefix to ensure cache hits; measure tail latencies.

Temporary mitigation notes
- If KV cache cold-start remains >1.5s, switch cache to tmpfs (mount -t tmpfs /var/lib/redwood/kvcache -o size=2G) and restart redwood-kvcache.
- If driver package is missing, fallback: install driver bundle from our staging s3 (we have local mirror path documented in Confluence).

Outstanding questions for customer / follow-ups
- Confirm whether customer will allow a small egress for telemetry to s3.redwood.ai for one-hour after install (we need to upload perf traces). If not, ask for local s3 mirror credentials.
- Ask networking team to confirm MTU on overlay (VXLAN) — we saw occasional fragmentation.
- Can they schedule a maintenance window to restart the ELB if we need to swap certs?

Quick reminders to self
- Export logs today, tag with JIRA-DEP-4721 before EOD.
- Capture KV latency histogram and upload to Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-2389).
- Write short howto for proxy ACL requirements (mateo to review).

Snippets to paste to slack/customer (draft)
- "Hi Jessica — quick update: bootstrap completed, runtime is up but we're investigating KV cold-start latency; next step I'll try a tmpfs-backed cache and report numbers in 2 hours. Also need proxy ACLs for ghcr registry."

Retro notes (after midday run)
- What worked: installer dry-run caught cert path mismatch early.
- What didn't: driver packaging dependency (need a packaged fallback in installer image).
- Action: add a preflight check for GPU driver presence and proxy ACL reachability in installer v2025-11.x.

End of scratchpad — will clean up and move important items into PR/Confluence today.
